usage: The word 蝦子撈麵 refers to a type of noodle dish tossed with shrimp roe.
You can use 蝦子撈麵 when ordering food or describing dishes with shrimp roe noodles.
As a noun, 蝦子撈麵 functions as the subject or object in sentences, such as 'I want to eat 蝦子撈麵.'
It is often used in casual conversations about meals, especially in Cantonese restaurants.
